scenario: Batch create repositories across a tenant from the spreadsheet textarea
preconditions: Requester is an active member of the tenant X_RepoAdmin team
form_inputs: org, tenant_name, repositories_csv with 3 rows (repository_name,repository_visibility,primary_contact,secondary_contact), approver, dry_run=true
expected_result: Status awaiting_approval; per-row plan to create each repository; no mutation

scenario: An already-existing repository row is a no-op
preconditions: Requester authorized; one requested repository already exists in the org
expected_result: No-op for the existing row; create for the missing rows

scenario: Tenant repo-admin team member is authorized for the whole batch
preconditions: Requester is an active member of the tenant X_RepoAdmin team
form_inputs: rows within the resolved tenant boundary

scenario: Tenant top-team (Tenant Admin) maintainer is authorized for the whole batch
preconditions: Requester is an active maintainer of the tenant top team
form_inputs: rows within the resolved tenant boundary

scenario: A requester who fails the create-repo gate has the whole request rejected
preconditions: Requester is neither a repo-admin team member nor a tenant top-team maintainer
expected_result: Tenant does not resolve; every row rejected; request invalid

scenario: Live batch create against a real tenant
form_inputs: valid rows, dry_run=false, approver posts approved
expected_result: Repositories created per row; tenant repo-admin team granted admin; caller added as RepoAdmin; owned topology persisted; per-row audit records applied/skipped/failed
